title: Senior App Developer/Mobile Architect Lead - iOS/Android Platform
description:
1) Position :Benovymed - Sr. App Developer (Android/ iOS / Hybrid)/ Mobile Architect Lead- Global Digital Health Startup.2) Job Location : Delhi NCR / Gurgaon, IndiaAt our Global HQ, Global Technology Development Center & Global R&D & AI Health Innovation Center, Delhi NCR, India.3) Job Description :We are looking for a strong experienced Android engineer, very strong at Coding, and bug fixing for Mobile app development from scratch and who should have worked in an early-stage tech start-up with highly scalable Tech Product development. Responsibility & Role :- Coding Android/iOS/Hybrid Mobile applications.- To Work in close coordination with all stakeholders of Product Owner, Solution Architect, Engineering Head, UX/UI designer, Fullstack Developer, and the testing to develop better products with fewer bugs.- To work with different APIs and data sources.- Fix bugs.- Continuous evaluation, discovering new technologies and exploiting them for the cross-functional platform.- Android developer's role in multi-function mobile applications.Required Skillsets :- Strong hands-on end-to-end in Kotlin, Java.- Strong knowledge of Android SDK, different versions of Android, and how to deal with different screen sizes- Familiarity with RESTful APIs to connect Android applications to back-end services- Strong knowledge of Android / iOS / Hybrid / Flutter principles, patterns, and best practices.- Android Studio. - Ability to understand and integrate with 3rd Party Application API.- Familiarity with cloud message APIs, client engagement, AI chatbot and push notifications features.- A knack for benchmarking and optimization.- Understanding of Google's Android principles and interface guidelines.- Familiarity with continuous integration. 4) Experience :- At least 2 -10 Years of experience post-qualification in an early-stage growing startup in any industry, preferably in Digital Health.- Must have worked in a mobile app product development in an early-stage startup from scratch, especially in a founding team.- Worked as a single-handed end-to-end from scratch in the Mobile App Development in Highly Scalable Andriod / iOS / Hybrid / Flutter Platform.5) Qualification : B.Tech in CSE / IT / ECE from a reputed engineering Institute.

Key Skills: Android Platform,Hybrid Apps,RESTful API,Java,Flutter,Mobile App Designing,iOS,Android Studio
